_A_TREE_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: The ATree component shows hierarchical data: nodes can be expanded, selected and checked, searched and loaded lazily. The data is plain JSON with configurable keys; with json any JSON value is shown as a tree.
_A_TREE_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION_:
Accessibility: the WAI-ARIA tree pattern (role="tree", treeitem, group with level, position, expanded, selected and checked state). Only one node is in the tab order, the arrow keys move the focus. The number of found nodes is announced.

  • ↑ ↓: next / previous node
  • →: open the node or go to the first child
  • ←: close the node or go to the parent
  • Home / End: first / last node
  • Enter: select
  • Space: check (with checkboxes) or select
  • *: open all nodes of the level
  • a–z: go to the next node starting with the letter
_A_TREE_GROUP_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: Nodes are objects with id, label and children. v-model:selected is the key of the selected node.
_A_TREE_GROUP_EXPAND_DESCRIPTION_: default-expand-level opens the first levels, is-expand-all all nodes. v-model:expanded holds the keys of the open nodes, the methods expandAll and collapseAll change them. is-accordion keeps only one node per level open; with is-expand-on-click-node false only the arrow opens a node.
_A_TREE_GROUP_CHECKBOX_DESCRIPTION_: is-checkbox shows checkboxes, v-model holds the checked keys. Checking a node checks its children; a parent is checked when all children are checked, otherwise it is partly checked. Disabled nodes are not changed.
_A_TREE_GROUP_CHECK_STRICTLY_DESCRIPTION: With is-check-strictly a checkbox changes only its own node.
_A_TREE_GROUP_SEARCH_DESCRIPTION_: search-model shows the matching nodes and their parents and highlights the text. filter-method replaces the search: ({ item, label, searchModel }) => boolean.
_A_TREE_GROUP_LAZY_DESCRIPTION_: load gets { item, key, level } and returns a Promise with the children; while loading the node shows a spinner. A node with isLeaf has no children. If the Promise is rejected, the node stays closed, can be opened again and load-error is emitted.
_A_TREE_GROUP_KEYS_DESCRIPTION_: The data does not need to be converted: key-id, key-label, key-children, key-disabled and key-is-leaf take a key, a path (meta.title) or a function ({ item }) => value.
_A_TREE_GROUP_SLOT_DESCRIPTION_: The slot node replaces the label and gets item, key, label, level, isExpanded, isLeaf, checked, isSelected and searchModel.
_A_TREE_GROUP_JSON_DESCRIPTION_: json shows any JSON value, e.g. a response of an API: keys, values by type, the size of objects and arrays. The search finds keys and values, the key of a node is its path ($.address.geo.lat).
_A_TREE_PROPS_ARIA_LABEL_: Accessible name of the tree (required if there is no aria-labelledby).
_A_TREE_PROPS_ARIA_LABELLEDBY_: Id of an element that names the tree.
_A_TREE_PROPS_DEFAULT_EXPAND_LEVEL_: Levels that are open at the start.
_A_TREE_PROPS_FILTER_METHOD_: Own search: ({ item, label, searchModel }) => boolean.
_A_TREE_PROPS_INDENT_: Indent of a level (number in pixels or CSS value).
_A_TREE_PROPS_IS_ACCORDION_: Only one open node per level.
_A_TREE_PROPS_IS_CHECK_ON_CLICK_NODE_: A click on the node changes the checkbox.
_A_TREE_PROPS_IS_CHECK_STRICTLY_: A checkbox changes only its own node.
_A_TREE_PROPS_IS_EXPAND_ALL_: All nodes are open at the start.
_A_TREE_PROPS_IS_EXPAND_ON_CLICK_NODE_: A click on the node opens and closes it.
_A_TREE_PROPS_JSON_: Any JSON value that is shown as a tree (instead of data).
_A_TREE_PROPS_KEY_CHILDREN_: Key, path or function of the children.
_A_TREE_PROPS_KEY_DISABLED_: Key, path or function of the disabled state.
_A_TREE_PROPS_KEY_ID_: Key, path or function of the unique key of a node.
_A_TREE_PROPS_KEY_IS_LEAF_: With load: key, path or function that marks a node without children.
_A_TREE_PROPS_KEY_LABEL_: Key, path or function of the label.
_A_TREE_PROPS_LOAD_: Loads children: ({ item, key, level }) => Promise<Array>.
_A_TREE_EVENTS_UPDATE_EXPANDED_: Keys of the open nodes changed.
_A_TREE_EVENTS_NODE_CLICK_: A node was selected by click or keyboard: { item, key, $event }.
_A_TREE_EVENTS_CHECK_: A checkbox was changed: { item, key, checked, checkedKeys, $event }.
_A_TREE_EVENTS_EXPAND_: A node was opened: { item, key, $event }.
_A_TREE_EVENTS_COLLAPSE_: A node was closed: { item, key, $event }.
_A_TREE_EVENTS_LOAD_ERROR_: load was rejected: { item, key, error }.
_A_TREE_SLOTS_NODE_: Content of a node instead of the label.
_A_TREE_METHODS_EXPANDTOKEY_KEY_: Opens the parents of a node.
_A_TREE_METHODS_FOCUS_KEY_: Focuses a node (by default the node in the tab order).
_A_TREE_METHODS_SETSELECTED_KEY_: Selects a node and opens its parents.
_A_TREE_METHODS_GETCHECKEDITEMS_ISLEAFON: Returns the checked items, optionally only leaves.
_A_TREE_METHODS_GETHALFCHECKEDKEYS_: Returns the keys of partly checked nodes.
_A_TREE_METHODS_GETNODE_KEY_: Returns the item of a key.
